qs.q: Main function of von Willebrand factor?
qs.e: vWF acts as a bridge between exposed subendothelial collagen and platelet GPIb receptors, initiating primary haemostasis.
qs.s: Haemostasis MCQs: Master Coagulation & Bleeding Control

qs.q: Von Willebrand factor (vWF) has two main functions
o: Platelet adhesion and Factor VIII carrier
Factor X activation and fibrinogen binding
qs.e: vWF bridges platelet GPIb receptors to exposed collagen and protects Factor VIII from degradation in plasma.
